name: qr-code
description: QR codes: generate PNG or SVG files (error correction, size, colours) and decode QR codes from local images in allowed directories

nodes.title: Generate a QR code
nodes.description: Encodes text or a URL as a QR code and writes it as a new PNG or SVG file in QR_CODE_OUTPUT_DIR (error correction, margin, size and colours adjustable)

text.description: Text or URL to encode (at most 4296 characters; less at higher error correction)

error_correction.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15%, Q 25%, H 30% of the code can be damaged

image_size.description: Total image width in pixels; overrides module_size

include_data.description: Also return the SVG text, or the PNG as a data: URL

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Decode QR codes
nodes.description: Finds and decodes QR codes (also Micro QR and rMQR) in a png, jpeg, gif or bmp image, returning each code's text, error correction level and corner positions

input.description: Image inside QR_CODE_INPUT_DIRS (or QR_CODE_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

try_harder.description: Spend more time: also try rotated and inverted images

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
